name: Yash Rawal
summary: Applied AI & Machine Learning Engineer serving a **1M+ user scale** by architecting enterprise agentic platforms, fine-tuning domain LLMs (Qwen2.5-7B, E5-large-v2) on A100 GPUs, and building automated evaluation control planes. Specialized in Python, high-throughput LLM serving internals (vLLM contributor), workflow orchestration (SAP Joule 2.0, LangGraph), and cloud-native infrastructure (Azure, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes).

bullets: Deployed a production-scale agentic platform and multi-agent systems serving **1M+ active ERP users** across 120+ enterprise tenants on cloud infrastructure (Azure, AWS).

Architected multi-agent routing with **LangGraph & SAP Joule 2.0** across 650+ dynamic MCP capabilities, engineering a capability contract layer in a single ReAct loop that reduced latency by 3x and token costs by 70%.

Fine-tuned and served **Qwen2.5-7B & E5-large-v2** models on A100 GPUs using PyTorch, Unsloth, and contrastive learning, deploying via vLLM on Azure for structured role mapping and semantic retrieval.
Implemented a 4-level hierarchical RAG pipeline in Python indexing 10,000+ technical documents using GROBID, pdfplumber, and PostgreSQL/PGVector, achieving a **90%+ Recall@10** retrieval rate.
Developed the Prompt Lab evaluation control plane in Python to collect reasoning trajectories and human preference annotations, establishing a scalable **Human Feedback (RLHF) Pipeline**.

Engineered clinical summarization pipelines in Python for 116K+ medical records with 4-bit quantized Llama 3, and built real-time WebSocket streaming for Indic ASR with **NeMo RNN-T & CTC decoding** (STFT, Mel-spectrograms, CNN architectures).
